title: Counter
description: A simple integer counter you can increment, decrement, or reset. It emits a change event on every update.

count.title: Count
count.description: The counter's current value; updates live as actions run.

increment.title: Increment
increment.description: Increase the count by one and emit a change event.

decrement.title: Decrement
decrement.description: Decrease the count by one and emit a change event.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Set the count back to zero and emit a change event.

change.title: Changed
change.description: Fires whenever the count changes, carrying the new value.
